evidence.record_quote: produce the Creative AI Tools & Resources Database , a database of tools for artists, designers, engineers, curators and researchers

The Creative AI Lab database is an ongoing project to aggregate tools and resources for artists, engineers, curators & researchers interested in incorporating machine learning (ML) and other forms of artificial intelligence (AI) into their practice.
